description: Persona cards for the SYNTHETIC-only M3 capture-path harness (ts/scripts/persona-sim.ts). Every card is grounded in material already in this repository: docs/user-guide.md 'Try It' prompts, docs/evaluation/persona-bench/README.md §1 frozen prompt, and docs/research/kimi-postmortem.md. A persona is a simulation, never a traveller: nothing produced from this deck can contribute to M3 or M4 exit evidence.

personas.title: Erhai weekend unwind, hard-constraint no-match
personas.grounding: docs/user-guide.md 'Try It: An Infeasible Dream Gets Caught'; data/golden_erhai.json
goals: Stare at Erhai lake and do nothing for a weekend
Leave Shanghai on Friday evening and be back for Monday
hard_constraints: This weekend only, two days, not negotiable
Total budget CNY 3000
No wake-up before 08:00
On annual leave: no work window at all
Nothing booked yet
personas.finalize_rule: Do not finalize if my stated destination is ruled out, even when alternatives look good — I came for Erhai. Finalize only if an Erhai-shaped plan fits the weekend.
personas.rating_rule: Rate 6 when the refusal is honest and alternatives come with wake-up time, arrival energy and all-in cost; rate 2 if the engine invents a feasible Erhai weekend.
personas.opening_message: 我想去洱海边发呆,就这周末,我在上海,预算3000,别让我早起。年假了不用办公,还没订任何东西。

persona_turns.message: 洱海这次去不了的话我就先不定了,谢谢。

personas.title: Two-week Phuket workation with a multi-leg chain
personas.grounding: docs/evaluation/persona-bench/README.md §1 frozen prompt; docs/research/kimi-postmortem.md M-1/F2; data/flights_2026.json
goals: Work remotely from Phuket for two weeks and meet my girlfriend there
Reach Bangkok for the weekend, then Yunnan, then be at work in Dubai Monday morning
hard_constraints: Employer time zone UTC+4, meeting hours 10:00-19:00 — no flight may cut into them
The Phuket hotel is already booked 7.18-7.23 and cannot move
7.18 morning is a Hong Kong bank appointment
personas.finalize_rule: Finalize once the plan respects the work window and keeps the booked hotel as a fixed anchor, and every leg states arrival energy.
personas.rating_rule: Rate 9 when work windows actually exclude conflicting flights with reasons; rate 5 if the plan silently replans my booked hotel.
personas.opening_message: 7.17周五22:40落地深圳,7.18早上去香港办银行开户&保险签约;争取7.18当天飞泰国普吉岛,跟女朋友见面,之后两周在普吉居家办公;8.10周一凌晨从深圳起飞,要在周一上班前到迪拜。请给我做机票和酒店的行程规划和推荐。

workWindow.evidence: 用户原话:工作时间是UTC+4的10:00到19:00

persona_turns.message: 我的工作时间是UTC+4的早上10点到下午7点,周一到周五。
我订了酒店:The Title East Wing Rawai,7.18入住 7.23 退房,这个不能改。
可以,就按这个方案定了。

personas.title: Phuket with parents, slow pace and no early departures
personas.grounding: docs/user-guide.md 'Try It: A Multi-Leg Trip with Work Windows' (companion-flow variant); docs/evaluation/persona-bench/README.md G4 companion passenger flow
goals: Take my parents to Phuket for a week at a slow pace
Keep every transfer short enough for them to handle
hard_constraints: No departure before 09:00 — my parents cannot do pre-dawn airports
At most one connection per direction
I still have to work: 09:00-18:00 Beijing time on weekdays
Nothing booked yet
personas.finalize_rule: Finalize when no leg departs before 09:00 and the plan says what each leg costs door to door.
personas.rating_rule: Rate 8 when early departures are excluded with a stated reason; rate 4 if a 06:00 wake-up is presented as fine.
personas.opening_message: 想带爸妈去普吉岛待一周,我还得远程上班。老人起不来早,别安排早班机,中转也别太折腾。还没订任何东西,帮我看看机票和酒店。

workWindow.evidence: 用户原话:09:00-18:00 北京时间

persona_turns.message: 我的工作时间是北京时间 9 点到 18 点,周一到周五。
都还没订,机票酒店都要你帮我看。
行,这个节奏爸妈可以,就这样定。

personas.title: Multi-leg red-eye that has to land before Monday work
personas.grounding: docs/evaluation/persona-bench/README.md G8 red-eye arrival state; docs/research/kimi-postmortem.md 「机场回来直接去上班」
goals: Get from Shenzhen to Dubai overnight and go straight to the office
Not be a wreck when I land
hard_constraints: Must be at the Dubai office Monday 10:00 local
Red-eye is acceptable, missing work is not
Employer time zone UTC+4, meeting hours 10:00-19:00
Return flight already booked
personas.finalize_rule: Finalize as soon as the plan reports arrival energy for the red-eye leg and does not collide with meeting hours.
personas.rating_rule: Rate 9 when arrival energy is computed rather than only ticket price; rate 3 if the overnight leg is presented with price alone.
personas.opening_message: 8.10周一凌晨从深圳起飞,要在迪拜周一上班前落地,机场直接去公司。帮我看机票。

personas.title: Budget-tight student, one week in Yunnan
goals: One week in Yunnan — Dali and Lijiang — on a student budget
Spend as little as possible on transport
hard_constraints: Hard ceiling CNY 4000 for everything
On leave for the week, no work window
Dates are flexible
Nothing booked yet
personas.finalize_rule: Finalize only if a concrete plan comes in under CNY 4000. An infeasibility verdict without a usable relaxation means I walk away.
personas.rating_rule: Rate 7 for an honest under-budget plan; rate 4 or lower when the refusal reason is not something I can act on.
personas.opening_message: 我请假一周去云南,大理丽江都想看看,预算4000以内全包,日期可以调。还没订任何东西。

persona_turns.message: 这个理由我没法处理,我先自己查吧。

personas.title: Vague wish, needs the interview to ask the load-bearing questions
personas.grounding: docs/user-guide.md 'Try It: A Return Visit' opening 「想出去走走」
goals: Go somewhere. I have not thought about where.
Be talked into something rather than fill in a form
hard_constraints: I will not volunteer dates, budget or destination unless asked directly
If asked more than three questions before I see anything concrete, I lose interest
personas.finalize_rule: Never finalize in this session — I am browsing. Abandon once my patience runs out.
personas.rating_rule: I never see a plan in this session, so I give no score at all: an M3 NPS answer belongs to a delivered plan and I refuse to invent one.

personas.title: Companion arriving separately, answers in single words
personas.grounding: docs/evaluation/persona-bench/README.md G4/G5 (companion flow; 「对岸万xx的海边小城」 = Krabi)
goals: Join my partner who is already in Phuket and dive around Krabi
hard_constraints: I fly from a different origin than my partner
I work European hours remotely: 15:00-23:00 local
My partner already booked the Phuket hotel
personas.finalize_rule: Finalize at the first plan that does not collide with my working hours.
personas.rating_rule: Rate 7 when my separate arrival chain is treated as its own passenger flow; rate 3 if the plan assumes one traveller.
personas.opening_message: 对象已经在普吉了,我从别的地方飞过去跟她碰头,想去对岸那个海边小城潜水。帮我看机票。
